reviews.decision_reason: select_demand preserves all supplied demand records in this package. The input corpus contains eight records with demand_score values from 9 through 3, and the selected/output states retain all eight records without unrelated additions or drops.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve assigned market-demand records without generic keyword expansion

reviews.decision_reason: normalize_evidence reindexes to the required fields, filters only the allowed record ids, and retains the same eight observed demand records. No contradictory or unrelated candidates are introduced here.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve assigned market-demand records and required fields

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance reverses the demand ordering: the runtime evidence ranks the lowest demand record n06-r08 first and highest demand record n06-r01 last. This contradicts the market-demand evidence in the input, where n06-r01 has demand_score 9 and n06-r07 has demand_score 4, and it materially drives the downstream recommendation to prioritize the weaker unsupported need instead of the strongest unsupported demand.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank provenance according to observed market demand strength
